why: Searches found only work on specific group classes (infinite dihedral group, group extensions, relatively hyperbolic groups, real rank-one Lie subgroups) proving the conjecture holds for those cases, plus a counterexample to a claimed simplification of permanence hypotheses (Meyer, Aug 2025) — none of this touches the general statement that the assembly map is an isomorphism, which was already known false in general (with coefficients) before the 2024 snapshot via Higson-Lafforgue-Skandalis counterexamples.
